prompt: Hey, I just signed up for MultiTool and want to get my Node.js API sending traces to it. I already have OpenTelemetry set up — it's currently exporting to a local Jaeger instance. Here are my files.

assertions.description: Output tracing.ts uses the exact MultiTool endpoint URL
Output tracing.ts uses 'api-key' as the header name (not x-api-key or authorization)
Output tracing.ts reads API key from MULTI_API_KEY env var
Output tracing.ts sets service.version/ATTR_SERVICE_VERSION from APP_VERSION env var
assertions.check: tracing.ts references APP_VERSION for the service version attribute

assertions.description: Output tracing.ts imports from the OTLP HTTP package (not gRPC)
The literal API key value is not present in any output code file
assertions.check: No output file contains the literal string 'mt_test_key_abc123'

assertions.description: Response includes step-by-step guidance for creating an API key in the MultiTool UI
assertions.check: response.md mentions navigating to API keys and copying the key value
